Qualifications include MS (G&O), MHA (Master of Hospital Administration - a management credential) and FICOG. Member of FOGSI, IAGE, ISGE and AGO. Independently vetted on iCareBetter, an international endometriosis-excision surgeon registry that requires surgical-video review. Runs her own patient-facing brand across a personal website, a clinic website, LinkedIn, a ~9,500-follower Instagram account and a Facebook page, and serves as a medical reviewer for MomJunction.
